verses.text: Den di heads of di papa houses of di Levites come near to Eleazar di priest, and to Joshua di pikin of Nun, and to di heads of di papa houses of di tribes of di pikin dem of Israel.
Dem speak to dem for Shiloh, for di land of Canaan, talk say, “Di Lord command by Moses say make dem give us cities to dwell inside, with dem pasture lands for our animals.”
So di pikin dem of Israel give di Levites out of dem inheritance, according to di commandment of di Lord, dis cities with dem pasture lands.
Di lot come out for di families of di Kohathites. Di pikin dem of Aaron di priest, wey be Levites, get 13 cities by lot from di tribe of Judah, from di tribe of Simeon and from di tribe of Benjamin.
Di rest of di pikin dem of Kohath get ten cities by lot from di families of di tribe of Ephraim, from di tribe of Dan and from di half tribe of Manasseh.
Di pikin dem of Gershon get 13 cities by lot from di families of di tribe of Issachar, from di tribe of Asher, from di tribe of Naphtali and from di half tribe of Manasseh for Bashan.
Di pikin dem of Merari, according to dem families, get 12 cities from di tribe of Reuben, from di tribe of Gad and from di tribe of Zebulun.
Di pikin dem of Israel give dis cities with dem pasture lands to di Levites by lot, as di Lord command by Moses.
Dem give from di tribe of di pikin dem of Judah and from di tribe of di pikin dem of Simeon dis cities wey dem call by name,
and dem be for di pikin dem of Aaron, wey be of di families of di Kohathites, of di pikin dem of Levi, because di first lot na dem own.
Dem give dem Kiriath Arba, di city of Arba wey be di papa of Anak, wey be Hebron, for di hill country of Judah, with di pasture lands round am.
But di fields of di city and di villages of am dem give to Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh as im own possession.
Dem give to di pikin dem of Aaron di priest Hebron, di city of refuge for di manslayer, with im pasture lands, and Libnah with im pasture lands,
Jattir with im pasture lands, Eshtemoa with im pasture lands,
Holon with im pasture lands, Debir with im pasture lands,
Ain with im pasture lands, Juttah with im pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with im pasture lands: nine cities out of dem two tribes.
Out of di tribe of Benjamin: Gibeon with im pasture lands, Geba with im pasture lands,
Anathoth with im pasture lands, and Almon with im pasture lands: four cities.
All di cities of di pikin dem of Aaron, di priests, na 13 cities with dem pasture lands.
Di families of di pikin dem of Kohath, di Levites wey remain of di pikin dem of Kohath, get cities by dem lot from di tribe of Ephraim.
Dem give dem Shechem, di city of refuge for di manslayer, with im pasture lands for di hill country of Ephraim, Gezer with im pasture lands,
Kibzaim with im pasture lands, and Beth Horon with im pasture lands: four cities.
Out of di tribe of Dan: Eltekeh with im pasture lands, Gibbethon with im pasture lands,
Aijalon with im pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with im pasture lands: four cities.
Out of di half tribe of Manasseh: Taanach with im pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with im pasture lands: two cities.
All di cities na ten with dem pasture lands for di families of di pikin dem of Kohath wey remain.

For di pikin dem of Gershon, of di families of di Levites, out of di half tribe of Manasseh: Golan for Bashan, di city of refuge for di manslayer, with im pasture lands, and Be Eshterah with im pasture lands: two cities.
Out of di tribe of Issachar: Kishion with im pasture lands, Daberath with im pasture lands,
Jarmuth with im pasture lands, En Gannim with im pasture lands: four cities.
Out of di tribe of Asher: Mishal with im pasture lands, Abdon with im pasture lands,
Helkath with im pasture lands, and Rehob with im pasture lands: four cities.
Out of di tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh for Galilee, di city of refuge for di manslayer, with im pasture lands, Hammoth Dor with im pasture lands, and Kartan with im pasture lands: three cities.
All di cities of di Gershonites according to dem families na 13 cities with dem pasture lands.
For di families of di pikin dem of Merari, di rest of di Levites, out of di tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam with im pasture lands, Kartah with im pasture lands,
Dimnah with im pasture lands, Nahalal with im pasture lands: four cities.
Out of di tribe of Reuben: Bezer with im pasture lands, Jahaz with im pasture lands,
Kedemoth with im pasture lands, and Mephaath with im pasture lands: four cities.
Out of di tribe of Gad: Ramoth for Gilead, di city of refuge for di manslayer, with im pasture lands, Mahanaim with im pasture lands,
Heshbon with im pasture lands, Jazer with im pasture lands: four cities in all.
All dis cities na for di pikin dem of Merari according to dem families, wey remain of di families of di Levites. Dem lot na 12 cities.
All di cities of di Levites inside di possession of di pikin dem of Israel na 48 cities with dem pasture lands.
Every one of dis cities get im pasture lands round am. E be so for all dis cities.
So di Lord give to Israel all di land wey e swear to give to dem papa dem. Dem possess am and dwell inside am.
Di Lord give dem rest round about, according to all wey e swear to dem papa dem. No man of all dem enemies stand before dem. Di Lord deliver all dem enemies into dem hand.
No one word fail of any good thing wey di Lord speak to di house of Israel. Everything happen.
Den Joshua call di Reubenites, di Gadites and di half tribe of Manasseh,
and talk to dem say, “You don keep all wey Moses di servant of di Lord command you, and you don obey my voice for all wey I command you.
You no leave your brothers dis plenty days till today, but you don keep di duty of di commandment of di Lord your God.

Now di Lord your God don give your brothers rest, as e promise dem. So now turn, go to your tents, to di land of your possession, wey Moses di servant of di Lord give you for di other side of di Jordan.

Only take strong care to do di commandment and di law wey Moses di servant of di Lord command you, to love di Lord your God, and to waka for all im ways, and to keep im commandments, and to hold tight to am, and to serve am with all your heart and with all your soul.”
So Joshua bless dem, and send dem away. Dem go to dem tents.

Now Moses don give one half of di tribe of Manasseh possession for Bashan, but to di other half Joshua give among dem brothers on dis side of di Jordan westward. Furthermore, when Joshua send dem away to dem tents, e bless dem,

and e speak to dem, talk, “Return with plenty riches to your tents, and with plenty cattle, with silver, with gold, with brass, with iron, and with plenty clothing. Share di plunder of your enemies with your brothers.”

So di pikin dem of Reuben, di pikin dem of Gad and di half tribe of Manasseh return, and depart from di pikin dem of Israel out of Shiloh, wey dey di land of Canaan, to go to di land of Gilead, to di land of dem possession, wey dem possess according to di commandment of di Lord by Moses.

When dem come to di region of di Jordan, wey dey di land of Canaan, di pikin dem of Reuben, di pikin dem of Gad and di half tribe of Manasseh build one altar dere by di Jordan, one altar wey big to look at.

Di pikin dem of Israel hear talk say, “Look, di pikin dem of Reuben, di pikin dem of Gad and di half tribe of Manasseh don build one altar for front of di land of Canaan, for di region of di Jordan, for di side wey belong to di pikin dem of Israel.”
When di pikin dem of Israel hear am, di whole congregation of di pikin dem of Israel gather together for Shiloh to go up against dem to war.
Di pikin dem of Israel send to di pikin dem of Reuben, to di pikin dem of Gad and to di half tribe of Manasseh, for di land of Gilead, Phinehas di pikin of Eleazar di priest,
and ten princes with am, one prince of every papa house out of all di tribes of Israel. Each one na head of im papa house among di thousands of Israel.
Dem come to di pikin dem of Reuben, to di pikin dem of Gad and to di half tribe of Manasseh, to di land of Gilead, and dem speak with dem, talk,

“Di whole congregation of di Lord talk say, ‘Wetin be dis trespass wey una don commit against di God of Israel, to turn away today from following di Lord, as una don build una one altar to rebel today against di Lord?
Di sin of Peor no small for us? We never make ourselves clean from am until dis day, though plague come on di congregation of di Lord,
and now una dey turn away today from following di Lord? Since una dey rebel today against di Lord, tomorrow e go vex with di whole congregation of Israel.

But if di land of your possession dey unclean, pass over to di land of di possession of di Lord, wia di Lord tabernacle dwell, and take possession among us. But no rebel against di Lord, nor rebel against us, by building una one altar beside di altar of di Lord our God.
Achan di pikin of Zerah no commit trespass for di devoted thing, and wrath come on di whole congregation of Israel? Dat man no perish alone for im sin.’”
Den di pikin dem of Reuben, di pikin dem of Gad and di half tribe of Manasseh answer, and talk to di heads of di thousands of Israel,
“Di Mighty One, God, di Lord! Di Mighty One, God, di Lord! E know, and Israel go know. If na rebellion, or if na trespass against di Lord, no save us today,
if we don build us one altar to turn away from following di Lord, or to offer burnt offering or grain offering on am, or to offer peace offerings on am, make di Lord imself punish am.
No, but we do am from fear, because of one reason, talk say, ‘For time wey go come your pikin dem fit speak to our pikin dem, talk, “Wetin una get to do with di Lord, di God of Israel?
For di Lord don make Jordan border between us and una, una pikin dem of Reuben and pikin dem of Gad. Una no get share for di Lord.” So your pikin dem go make our pikin dem stop to fear di Lord.’
Therefore we talk say, ‘Make we now get ready to build us one altar, no be for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice,

but make e be witness between us and una, and between our generations after us, say we go perform di service of di Lord before am with our burnt offerings, with our sacrifices and with our peace offerings, so that your pikin dem no go talk to our pikin dem for time wey go come, “Una no get share for di Lord.”’

Therefore we talk say, ‘If e happen say dem talk so to us or to our generations for time wey go come, den we go talk say, “Look di pattern of di altar of di Lord, wey our papa dem make, no be for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice, but na witness between us and una.”’

Far be am from us say we go rebel against di Lord, and turn away today from following di Lord, to build one altar for burnt offering, for grain offering or for sacrifice, beside di altar of di Lord our God wey dey before im tabernacle.”

When Phinehas di priest and di princes of di congregation, di heads of di thousands of Israel wey dey with am, hear di words wey di pikin dem of Reuben, di pikin dem of Gad and di pikin dem of Manasseh speak, e please dem.

Phinehas di pikin of Eleazar di priest talk to di pikin dem of Reuben, to di pikin dem of Gad and to di pikin dem of Manasseh, “Today we know say di Lord dey among us, because una no commit dis trespass against di Lord. Now una don deliver di pikin dem of Israel out of di hand of di Lord.”

Phinehas di pikin of Eleazar di priest, and di princes, return from di pikin dem of Reuben and from di pikin dem of Gad, out of di land of Gilead, to di land of Canaan, to di pikin dem of Israel, and bring dem word again.

Di thing please di pikin dem of Israel. Di pikin dem of Israel bless God, and dem no talk again of going up against dem to war, to destroy di land wia di pikin dem of Reuben and di pikin dem of Gad dey dwell.
Di pikin dem of Reuben and di pikin dem of Gad call di altar Witness, talk say, “E na witness between us say di Lord na God.”
E come be say, plenty days after di Lord don give Israel rest from all dem enemies round about, Joshua don old and don reach plenty years.
Joshua call all Israel, dem elders, dem heads, dem judges and dem officers, and talk to dem, “I don old and I don reach plenty years.
Una don see all wey di Lord your God do to all dem nations because of una, for na di Lord your God wey dey fight for una.
Look, I don share to una by lot dem nations wey remain, to be inheritance for your tribes, from di Jordan, with all di nations wey I don cut off, even to di great sea toward di going down of di sun.
Di Lord your God, e go thrust dem out from before you, and drive dem from your sight. You go possess dem land, as di Lord your God promise you.
So una must be very strong to keep and do all wey dey written for di book of di law of Moses, so that una no turn aside from am to di right hand or to di left,
so that una no go enter among dem nations, dem wey remain among una. No make mention of dem gods name, nor make person swear by dem, nor serve dem, nor bow down to dem,
but hold tight to di Lord your God, as una don do to dis day.
For di Lord don drive out from before una great nations and strong. As for una, no man don stand before una to dis day.
One man of una go chase one thousand, for na di Lord your God e be wey dey fight for una, as e promise una.
So take good care, so that una love di Lord your God.
Else if una go back in any way, and hold tight to di remnant of dem nations, even dem wey remain among una, and make marriages with dem, and go in to dem, and dem to una,

know for sure say di Lord your God no go continue to drive out dem nations from before una, but dem go be snare and trap to una, and whip for your sides, and thorns for your eyes, until una perish from dis good land wey di Lord your God don give una.

Look, today I dey go di way of all di earth. Una know with all your hearts and with all your souls say no one thing don fail of all di good things wey di Lord your God speak concerning una. All don come to pass for una. No one of dem don fail.

E go happen say as all di good things don come on una wey di Lord your God promise una, so di Lord go bring on una all di evil things, until e don destroy una from off dis good land wey di Lord your God don give una,

when una go transgress di covenant of di Lord your God, wey e command una, and go serve other gods, and bow down to dem. Den di anger of di Lord go burn against una, and una go perish quick from off di good land wey e don give una.”
Joshua gather all di tribes of Israel to Shechem, and call for di elders of Israel, for dem heads, for dem judges and for dem officers. Dem stand before God.

Joshua talk to all di people, “Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: ‘Your papa dem dey dwell for old time beyond di River, Terah di papa of Abraham and di papa of Nahor. Dem serve other gods.
I take your papa Abraham from di other side of di River, and lead am throughout all di land of Canaan, and multiply im seed, and give am Isaac.
I give to Isaac Jacob and Esau. I give to Esau mount Seir to possess am. Jacob and im pikin dem go down into Egypt.
I send Moses and Aaron, and I plague Egypt, according to wetin I do among dem. After dat I bring una out.
I bring your papa dem out of Egypt. Una come to di sea. Di Egyptians pursue your papa dem with chariots and with horsemen to di Red Sea.
When dem cry out to di Lord, e put darkness between una and di Egyptians, and bring di sea on dem, and cover dem. Your eyes see wetin I do for Egypt. Una dwell for di wilderness plenty days.
I bring una into di land of di Amorites wey dwell beyond di Jordan. Dem fight with una. I give dem into your hand. Una possess dia land. I destroy dem from before una.
Den Balak di pikin of Zippor, king of Moab, rise up and fight against Israel. E send call Balaam di pikin of Beor to curse una.
But I no go listen to Balaam. So e bless una still. So I deliver una out of im hand.

Una go over di Jordan, and come to Jericho. Di men of Jericho fight against una, di Amorites, di Perizzites, di Canaanites, di Hittites, di Girgashites, di Hivites and di Jebusites. I deliver dem into your hand.
I send di hornets before una, wey drive dem out from before una, even di two kings of di Amorites. No be with your sword, nor with your bow.
I give una land wey una no labour for, and cities wey una no build, and una dwell inside dem. Una dey eat of vineyards and olive groves wey una no plant.’
So now, fear di Lord, and serve am for sincerity and for truth. Put away di gods wey your papa dem serve beyond di River and for Egypt, and serve di Lord.

If e dey bad for your eyes to serve di Lord, choose today wey una go serve: whether di gods wey your papa dem serve wey dey beyond di River, or di gods of di Amorites, for dia land wey una dey dwell. But as for me and my house, we go serve di Lord.”
Di people answer, “Far be am from us say we go forsake di Lord, to serve other gods;

for na di Lord our God e be wey bring us and our papa dem up out of di land of Egypt, from di house of bondage, and wey do dem great signs for our sight, and keep us for all di way wey we waka, and among all di peoples wey we pass through.
Di Lord drive out from before us all di peoples, even di Amorites wey dwell for di land. So we go serve di Lord too, for e na our God.”
Joshua talk to di people, “Una no fit serve di Lord, for e na holy God. E na jealous God. E no go forgive your disobedience nor your sins.
If una forsake di Lord, and serve strange gods, den e go turn and do una evil, and consume una, after e don do una good.”
Di people talk to Joshua, “No; but we go serve di Lord.”
Joshua talk to di people, “Una na witnesses against una own self say una don choose di Lord to serve am.” Dem talk say, “We na witnesses.”
E talk say, “Now so put away di strange gods wey dey among una, and turn your heart to di Lord, di God of Israel.”
Di people talk to Joshua, “Di Lord our God we go serve, and im voice we go obey.”
So Joshua make covenant with di people dat day, and set dem statute and ordinance for Shechem.
Joshua write dis words for di book of di law of God. E take one great stone, and set am up dere under di oak wey dey by di sanctuary of di Lord.
Joshua talk to all di people, “Look, dis stone go be witness against us, for e don hear all di words of di Lord wey e speak to us. E go be witness against una, so that una no deny your God.”
So Joshua send di people away, every man to im inheritance.
E come be say after dis things, Joshua di pikin of Nun, di servant of di Lord, die, wey don reach 110 years.
Dem bury am for di border of im inheritance for Timnath Serah, wey dey di hill country of Ephraim, for di north of di mountain of Gaash.
Israel serve di Lord all di days of Joshua, and all di days of di elders wey outlive Joshua, and wey don know all di work of di Lord, wey e don do for Israel.

Dem bury di bones of Joseph, wey di pikin dem of Israel bring up out of Egypt, for Shechem, for di piece of ground wey Jacob buy from di pikin dem of Hamor, di papa of Shechem, for 100 pieces of silver. Dem become di inheritance of di pikin dem of Joseph.
Eleazar di pikin of Aaron die. Dem bury am for Gibeah of Phinehas im pikin man, wey dem give am for di hill country of Ephraim.
